Control panel

A screen for the wall you actually look at.

The panel that runs a room from one place: scenes, lights, climate and cameras, with the clock and the weather sitting on it the rest of the day.

WhatsApp about this See the full range
  • Finish: Black glass
  • Power: Neutral wire needed
  • Control: Touch, app, Alexa
  • Fit: Existing back box

What it does

One plate, several jobs.

Scenes, in one press

“Home mode” and “Leave mode” sit on the screen ready-made, and you can add more as you use the house.

Runs the room it is mounted in

Lights, climate, and whichever cameras you have paired to it, all from the one screen.

The clock and the weather

It is the thing your eye rests on anyway, so it earns its place on the wall between scenes.

The same controls on your phone

Leave the room and the panel comes with you.

How it works

Plain wiring, a different surface.

The panel sits in the back box already in your wall, the same one that held the old switch plate. What is different from a plain touch switch is that it is powered, so it needs a neutral wire behind it — the one thing we check for on the free visit, before you commit to anything. Touch runs the screen directly; the same scenes are also reachable from the app, or from Alexa if the room is paired to it.

Where it fits

Not only one kind of room.

Homes

The panel by the front door or the main bedroom is usually the one that gets touched the most — worth putting it where a hand naturally lands.

Hotels

One panel by the bed does the job of a row of switches a guest would otherwise have to guess at.

Flats and apartments

Fits the existing back box, so a flat that is already decorated does not need to be opened up to get one.

Questions about this one

What people ask before they book.

Does it need special wiring?
A neutral wire, which most modern back boxes already have. We check on the free visit rather than guessing over WhatsApp.
Does it work with Alexa?
Yes — pair the room and the same scenes on the screen answer to voice.
What happens if my phone dies or the wifi drops?
The screen itself does not need your phone. Touch still runs the room; you only lose the phone and voice layer until the connection is back.
